# PetDate

> PetDate (پت‌دیت) is the Persian pet playmate, pet shop, adoption, and online vet-consult platform. Web and Telegram share one account.

پت‌دیت پلتفرم فارسی همبازی پت، پت‌شاپ، پذیرش حیوان خانگی و مشاوره دامپزشک آنلاین است. زبان اصلی فارسی (fa) با رابط راست‌به‌چپ است. English UI is available. Veterinary support is online consultation, not a clinic directory or diagnosis guarantee.

## Product

- [Home](https://petdate.ir/): landing — playmate, vet, trainer, no-pet, and adoption
- [FAQ and help](https://petdate.ir/faq): frequently asked questions (`/help` is the same page)
- [Pet shop](https://petdate.ir/shop): public catalog; checkout needs login
- [Adoption](https://petdate.ir/adoption): pets available for پذیرش
- [Vet consult](https://petdate.ir/vet-consult): online veterinary consultation
- [Magazine](https://petdate.ir/magazine): care articles
- [Pet games](https://petdate.ir/games): casual games
- [OTP login](https://petdate.ir/auth/login): sign in (web and Telegram share one account)

## Roles

- Pet owner (صاحب پت): find a playmate (همبازی) for a dog or cat
- Veterinarian (دامپزشک): online consult desk, not a physical clinic listing
- Trainer (مربی): training consult
- No-pet (بدون پت): browse and complete a role later
- Adopter: browse [adoption listings](https://petdate.ir/adoption)

Playmate chat, wallet checkout, and most app surfaces require login. Public marketing routes above do not.
